review_candidates.title: General Counsel
review_candidates.description: About the Role El Ezaby Pharmacy is seeking an accomplished and commercially minded General Counsel to lead its Legal Department and serve as the principal legal adviser to the CEO, Board, and Executive Leadership Team. This senior leadership role is responsible for protecting the company's legal, commercial, regulatory, and reputational interests while enabling business growth, strategic investments, and sound corporate decision-making. The General Counsel will lead the development of a proactive, business-oriented legal function that provides strategic counsel, manages enterprise-wide legal risks, strengthens corporate governance, and ensures effective legal support across the company's operations. The successful candidate will bring extensive experience in corporate and commercial law, mergers and acquisitions (M&A), complex contract negotiations, regulatory compliance, and legal team leadership, ideally within a large, complex, or regulated business environment. Key Responsibilities 1. Executive Legal Advisory and Leadership Serve as the principal legal adviser to the CEO, Board, and Executive Leadership Team on strategic, commercial, corporate, and regulatory matters. Translate complex legal issues into clear, practical recommendations that support informed business decisions and sustainable growth. Identify, assess, and proactively mitigate material legal, financial, regulatory, and reputational risks. Partner with business leaders to enable strategic initiatives while maintaining appropriate legal safeguards and governance standards. 2. Legal Department Leadership Lead, manage, and develop the existing Legal Department, establishing clear responsibilities, priorities, performance standards, and service expectations. Build a responsive, commercially focused legal function that balances business enablement with effective risk management. Develop the department's operating model, resource plans, budget, capabilities, and succession strategy. Manage external legal advisers and law firms, ensuring quality, efficiency, cost effectiveness, and appropriate knowledge transfer. 3. M&A, Strategic Transactions, and Investments Lead the legal workstream for acquisitions, disposals, investments, joint ventures, restructurings, and strategic partnerships from initial assessment through completion. Oversee legal due diligence covering corporate ownership, regulatory status, licences, contracts, litigation, employment, real estate, intellectual property, and other material exposures. Structure and negotiate transaction documents to ensure alignment with agreed commercial terms and appropriate allocation of risks and responsibilities. Establish and monitor conditions precedent, warranties, indemnities, payment protections, completion deliverables, escrow or retention arrangements, and post-completion obligations, as appropriate. Maintain disciplined transaction documentation, closing checklists, approval records, and post-signing action plans to ensure outstanding matters are tracked through resolution. 4. Commercial Contracting and Risk Management Oversee the drafting, review, and negotiation of complex commercial agreements, including supplier, distribution, equipment, technology, property, lease, and service contracts. Ensure contractual terms clearly define payment obligations, performance standards, acceptance criteria, handover requirements, liability, termination rights, and dispute resolution mechanisms. Establish contract templates, negotiation guidelines, approval thresholds, and standard legal protections to improve consistency and efficiency. Ensure material contractual commitments are supported by appropriate documentation, approvals, licenses, and clearly defined completion requirements. 5. Regulatory Compliance, Licensing, and Governance Monitor relevant legal and regulatory developments and advise on their implications for the company's operations and growth strategy. Provide legal oversight of pharmacy, healthcare, warehouse, distribution, importation, and other regulated business activities. Ensure appropriate verification of licenses, permits, registrations, approvals, and applicable ownership or change-of-control requirements. Advise on corporate governance, statutory obligations, directors' duties, delegated authorities, and internal approval frameworks. Oversee Board and shareholder documentation, corporate resolutions, powers of attorney, statutory filings, and legal entity records. 6. Litigation, Investigations, and Dispute Resolution Lead the company's legal strategy for litigation, commercial disputes, claims, investigations, and other contentious matters. Assess legal exposure, potential remedies, settlement options, commercial implications, and reputational risks. Manage external counsel and ensure appropriate control over case strategy, scope, deadlines, fees, and outcomes. Oversee sensitive internal investigations, ensuring confidentiality, appropriate evidence preservation, and compliance with applicable legal requirements. 7. Employment, Real Estate, Data Protection, and Intellectual Property Advise HR and management on employment contracts, disciplinary matters, investigations, terminations, labor disputes, and sensitive employee relations issues. Oversee legal aspects of property acquisitions, leases, landlord arrangements, ownership and title verification, registrations, possession, and handover. Protect the company's brands, intellectual property, confidential information, and customer and employee data. Provide legal guidance on digital initiatives, technology projects, e-commerce, and data-related matters. 8. Legal Operations and Reporting Implement effective contract lifecycle management, legal matter tracking, document control, obligation monitoring, and renewal management processes. Maintain an up-to-date legal risk register and provide clear reporting to the CEO and relevant governance forums on material exposures, disputes, compliance matters, and mitigation plans. Establish appropriate controls for the secure management of legal records, licenses, original property documents, transaction files, and confidential communications. Leverage technology, standardization, and performance data to improve legal service delivery, turnaround times, cost management, and operational efficiency. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Law; a postgraduate qualification in Corporate, Commercial, or Business Law is preferred. Qualified lawyer with the right to practice in Egypt or another relevant jurisdiction, supported by a strong understanding of Egyptian legal and regulatory requirements. At least 15 years of progressive legal experience, including substantial in-house leadership experience in a large, complex, or regulated organization. Proven experience leading and developing a legal team and managing external legal advisers. Extensive expertise in corporate and commercial law, complex contract drafting and negotiation, M&A, investments, legal due diligence, and strategic transactions. Demonstrated experience managing transaction risks, conditions precedent, warranties, indemnities, payment protections, completion mechanics, and post-completion obligations. Strong understanding of regulatory compliance, corporate governance, licensing, employment law, real estate, competition, intellectual property, and data protection. Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, retail, or other highly regulated, multi-site businesses is highly desirable. Proven ability to advise CEOs, Boards, and senior executives on commercially significant and time-sensitive matters. Strong legal drafting and negotiation skills in both Arabic and English. Excellent leadership, analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and commercial decision-making capabilities. Key Competencies Strategic legal advisory and executive judgement Commercial awareness and pragmatic risk management Corporate governance and regulatory leadership M&A, transaction management, and due diligence Complex contract negotiation and drafting Litigation and dispute resolution strategy Legal team leadership and external counsel management Accuracy, confidentiality, and document governance Strong stakeholder engagement and cross-functional collaboration

review_candidates.title: Software Engineer - Ubuntu Server Certification
review_candidates.description: Canonical is hiring a software engineer to join the Server Certification team. The Certification team develops Python based testing tools used to test Ubuntu Server on the latest enterprise hardware ensuring Ubuntu users have the best experience with their hardware. We work at the interface of hardware and software, so the ideal candidate is a Python developer with a problem solving mindset, familiar with hardware. Server Certification team represents Canonical to our datacenter hardware partners. We work together with silicon companies, OEMs, ODMs and teams within Canonical to ensure a smooth, secure out of the box Ubuntu experience, with success in this role leading to a great Ubuntu experience being offered on more and more devices. We focus on the interaction between server hardware and Ubuntu Linux, so the ideal candidate has software development experience and a good understanding of configuring and troubleshooting server hardware running Linux. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to have a meaningful impact on the adoption of Linux on enterprise server hardware across multiple industries. Canonical offers a fun, fast-paced team environment and a career full of learning and development opportunities. This team is centered in North and South American time zones. What you’ll do Contribute to Canonical’s open source testing tools such as Checkbox and Testflinger. Troubleshoot issues related to hardware compatibility, functionality, and performance. Technically support Canonical’s hardware partners in their hardware certification efforts. Educate the partner about Canonical’s tools, processes, and product roadmaps. Support Canonical’s internal teams on customer deployments of Canonical’s suite of Datacenter and Cloud products that utilize the partner’s hardware. Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 times per year for internal and external events. Who you are You have a good knowledge of Python and shell scripting. You have knowledge of server-class hardware. You know your way around Ubuntu, virtualization, and cloud computing concepts. You are confident in a customer-facing role. Desired Skills And Experience Experience with test automation tools for validating hardware compatibility. Knowledge of CI/CD concepts. Comfortable with some virtualization or container technologies such as QEMU, KVM, LXC / LXD, Docker. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. We truly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better platform for our users and customers. This is something we value deeply and we encourage everyone to come be a part of the world of Ubuntu.

review_candidates.title: Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: Summary / Position Purpose We are seeking a Software Engineer – ERP Systems to join our growing IT team! In this role, you will design, develop, test, and maintain software applications that drive our distribution and warehousing business forward across the Infor ecosystem. Working alongside senior engineers and business teams, you’ll build, extend, and support the platforms that run the business—with a primary focus on Infor CloudSuite Distribution (CSD) and Total Warehouse Logistics (TWL). The ideal candidate has a passion for clean, scalable code, thrives in a collaborative team environment, and enjoys solving real-world distribution and warehouse problems (order-to-cash, procurement, inventory, receiving, putaway, replenishment, shipping, and fulfillment) with innovative solutions. This is a hands-on development role suited to an early-career engineer (roughly 1–3 years of experience). Essential Duties, Functions, And/or Responsibilities ERP Development & Customization Design, develop, test, and deploy high-quality customizations, extensions, and enhancements within Infor CloudSuite Distribution (CSD) and related distribution modules, in alignment with business needs and technical requirements. Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code—including business logic, reports, batch processes, and automation—using SQL, JavaScript, and Python. Develop and maintain custom programs supporting order management, purchasing, inventory control, pricing, and warehouse/fulfillment workflows. Help enhance and modernize legacy ERP code while preserving the stability of mission-critical systems. Warehouse Configuration & Support Configure and support workflows and application settings across Total Warehouse Logistics (TWL) and CSD warehouse modules. Support core warehouse business processes: receiving, putaway, order selection, replenishment, inventory control, and shipping. Assist with system validation and testing ahead of releases and go-lives. Collaboration & Solution Design Collaborate with product managers, business stakeholders, and fellow engineers to understand requirements and deliver impactful solutions. Translate business requirements into functional and technical designs, favoring solutions that fit the standard Infor product where possible and minimizing unnecessary customization. Document technical designs, configurations, data flows, and solution logic for maintainability and knowledge transfer. Integrations & Data Build and support integrations between the ERP, TWL, finance, e-commerce, EDI, and third-party/back-office systems using RESTful APIs, middleware, and data interfaces. Develop reports, extracts, and data transformations to support operational and financial reporting. Help ensure data consistency and integrity across integrated platforms. Quality, Testing & Support Participate in code reviews and contribute to team best practices and coding standards. Debug and resolve software defects and performance issues, providing root-cause analysis for production issues. Follow source control, CI/CD, testing, and deployment best practices to deliver predictable releases and reduce technical debt over time. Directly and indirectly responsible for product quality. Continuous Improvement Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends to continuously improve development practices. Other duties as assigned. Qualifications Education and/or Work Experience Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent work experience). 1–3 years of software development experience in a professional environment, ideally supporting ERP or business applications. Strong programming experience with SQL, JavaScript, and Python (required). Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git). Solid understanding of the software development life cycle (SDLC), agile methodologies, and DevOps practices. Experience with RESTful APIs, and familiarity with microservices architecture Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases. Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, Google Cloud). Exposure to or experience with Infor CloudSuite Distribution (CSD) or a comparable distribution ERP. Familiarity with distribution and/or warehouse business processes: order management, procurement, inventory, receiving, putaway, replenishment, shipping, and pricing. Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills; excellent verbal and written communication. Self-motivated with the ability to work independently or within a team, with strong attention to detail and a passion for quality. Preferred Experience OpenEdge ABL (Progress 4GL) development experience (a plus). Infor ION, PaaS, or workflow/automation experience (a plus). Experience with Total Warehouse Logistics (TWL) configuration and processes. Exposure to cloud-native architectures and modern enterprise integration frameworks. Experience in a multi-entity, multi-brand, or multi-warehouse environment. Physical Requirements Ability to safely and successfully perform the essential job functions consistent with the ADA, FMLA, and other federal, state, and local standards, including meeting qualitative and/or quantitative productivity standards. Ability to maintain regular, punctual attendance consistent with the ADA, FMLA, and other federal, state, and local standards. Success in This Role Looks Like Business needs are translated into stable, well-designed ERP and warehouse solutions. Customizations and integrations are delivered predictably and adopted well by end-users. Production issues are resolved efficiently with solid root-cause analysis. Technical debt and unnecessary customization decrease over time. ERP, warehouse, and connected systems integrate cleanly across the distribution operation. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.
